title: Error: pasta failed with exit code 1: Couldn't set IPv4 route(s) in guest: Network is unreachable
body:
### Issue Description

Describe your issue
I have run into almost the same issue as described in #26157 where pasta fails exit code 1.
I was trying to start a simple container using the following command 
```
podman run -it -v suseStuff:/data opensuse/leap:15.6 bash
```
The container fails to start even with the volume binding removed.

which results in 
```
Error: pasta failed with exit code 1:
Couldn't set IPv4 route(s) in guest: Network is unreachable
```

The described issue happens on Fedora 44. I have a secondary laptop which also runs Fedora 44, and the issue does not occur on my secondary machine. Both are Fedora Workstation, with updates installed.

 Failing machine:
Pasta version
```
pasta 0^20260728.gf8df3f1-2.fc44.x86_64
```

SELinux permission from related issue:
```
ls -Z /usr/bin/podman
system_u:object_r:container_runtime_exec_t:s0 /usr/bin/podman
```

Looking through the differences, I can't find anything that would stand out to me

This is a pasta issue, not podman, so likely the best place to report this would be on the official passt bug tracker not here.
https://bugs.passt.top/

Anyhow I can ping the pasta maintainer here if that is easier, cc @sbrivio-rh

In general the error suggest a routing issue so please show the routes from your host `ip route` and to reproduce without podman `pasta --debug --config-net ip route` would be good to run to see what addresses it picked.

Appreciate the reply, considering I found a similar issue here (at least it appears that to me) I thought it was a good spot to create the issue. Either way, if it is preferred, the discussion can be moved over to pasta bug tracker.
